verdict.rationale: Aircall documents a Public API that supports Basic Authentication and OAuth, with endpoints that drive core product actions: starting outbound calls, pausing and resuming recordings, retrieving transcriptions and summaries, managing campaigns, and sending SMS. It also documents URL-based versioning and a changelog. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (only a Postman collection exists), independent or hands-on corroboration of the API, and an openly documented sandbox or test environment (test access is limited to approved partners).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Detailed step-by-step guide to interact with the Aircall Public API using Basic Authentication.
